description:
C++ Programmer/Linux

Amano is looking for a flexible and dynamic software developer to join our team. If you have good C++ and Linux development knowledge and want to envision together with us our advanced products, then we’d love you to join our team.

Amano is global Parking business leader and development of our Parking products requires creativity and implication from every development team and people involved in the process. All parties (development, testing, sales, support, distributors) are actively providing input and contributes to product development by envisioning and implementing constructively new ideas.

Your position will be to maintain and develop further functionalities on our parking products. This would require advanced C++, PostgreSQL and Linux knowledge.

The job is at the office of Amano Europe Bucharest (temporarily visits to Germany/Belgium might be required) - no remote work possible.

Required technologies:

  • C++ - Advanced
  • Linux Environment - Advanced
  • Database, SQL (PostgreSQL) - Medium
  • Networking and interprocess communication - Medium
  • Scripting (bash) - Medium
  • Software analyse and design - Medium

Benefits:

  • Attractive salary
  • Medical package
  • Meal tickets
  • Pleasant working environment. Colleagues ready to help when needed
  • Flexibility in working time
